# [Feat] speculative: Add native UBTree decoding for Ling3

## Motivation

This PR provides native SGLang inference support for the released UBTree draft checkpoints:

- [inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree), paired with [Ling-3.0-tiny](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny).
- [inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree), paired with [Ling-3.0-flash](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash).

UBTree combines a parallel DFlash proposer with a learned bigram selector to build a proposal tree. The target verifies the tree in one forward pass and commits the accepted continuation. The draft checkpoints are used alongside their matching target models and share the target's token embeddings and LM head.

For KDA linear attention, saving a complete recurrent state for every proposal node adds memory traffic and temporary storage. This PR uses a shared pre-tree state and per-node factors, then folds only the accepted path into persistent state. It also includes checkpoint loading, tree construction, and fixed-width CUDA Graph execution in SGLang.

## Modifications

- Native UBTree serving for Ling3 Tiny and Flash: built-in algorithm registration, draft-checkpoint loading, selector caches, tensor-parallel vocabulary top-k, and proposal-tree construction.
- Factorized Triton KDA tree verification using a shared pre-tree recurrent state and root-to-node factors.
- Fused causal convolution and tree transformation to prepare factor-generation inputs with fewer intermediate launches and tensor transfers.
- Accepted-path KDA/convolution-state and target/draft-KV commit through a shared verification epilogue for eager execution and CUDA Graph replay.
- Fixed-width BS=1 full decode CUDA Graph execution covering draft proposals, target verification, and accepted-path commit.
- FA3 tree-verification metadata with a `QLEN_ONLY` visibility mask.
- NVIDIA L20X Triton 3.7.1 MoE forward and down-projection tuning configurations for Ling expert shapes.
- Component, selector, tree-topology, kernel, backend, and CUDA Graph replay regression tests.

## Supported Scope

| Item | Supported configuration |
|---|---|
| Target models | Ling-3.0-tiny and Ling-3.0-flash (`BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM`) |
| Released draft checkpoints | [Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree) and [Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree), both B16 |
| Ling3 Tiny verification | 49 nodes; TP1 startup validated |
| Ling3 Flash verification | 32 nodes; TP4 startup validated |
| Ling3 Flash draft blocks | 8 and 16 exercised during development; the linked release is B16 |
| Scheduling | One active request, greedy decoding, DP=1, PP=1 |
| Linear attention backend | Triton KDA |
| Full attention backend | FA3 for both target and draft, page size 1 |
| CUDA Graph | Fixed-width full decode, BS=1; prefill graphs and graph padding disabled |

**B16 is the draft block size, not the verification-tree width.** Select the runtime verification width with `--speculative-num-draft-tokens`; the current native path supports 32 or 49 nodes within the checkpoint's tree budget.

## Integration Boundary

This PR includes the SGLang runtime support needed to serve the two linked UBTree releases:

- draft-checkpoint loading and selector-cache materialization;
- proposal-node selection and tree construction;
- factorized KDA verification and recurrent-state management;
- accepted-path state and KV commit;
- FA3 tree metadata and CUDA Graph capture/replay.

Model training, checkpoint export, and model weights remain outside SGLang. The native serving path does not require an external Ling-Spec UBTree runtime plugin.

UBTree dispatch uses the built-in algorithm and explicit tree metadata. Backend regression tests cover the existing snapshot path alongside the new tree path.

Launch with `--speculative-algorithm UBTREE` and the matching `--speculative-draft-model-path`. The [Tiny model card](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree#serving-with-sglang) and [Flash model card](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree#serving-with-sglang) provide full launch commands using the PR's [`asahi/ubtree` branch](https://github.com/AsaHIXx/sglang/tree/asahi/ubtree).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

### Test protocol

The table below retains the previously reported PR measurements. Their benchmark revision was not specified in the original description.

| Item | Setting |
|---|---|
| Datasets | GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME25, HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench |
| Model | Ling3 Flash |
| Batch size | 1 |
| Sampling | `temperature=0` |
| Maximum output | `max_new_tokens=2048` |
| EOS | Retained |
| Full attention | FA3 |
| Linear attention | Triton KDA |
| CUDA Graph | Full decode CUDA Graph, fixed BS=1 |
| Settings | UBTree: 32 nodes / B16; DSpARK: 9 nodes / B8 or B16 |
| GPU | 4× NVIDIA L20X |

### Reproduce command

The released [Tiny](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree#benchmark-results) and [Flash](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree#benchmark-results) model cards contain reproduce server commands.

### Results

Each cell shows **tokens/s / average acceptance length**. Acceptance length includes the bonus token.

| Dataset | UBTree-32 B16 TPS / AcceptLen | DSpARK-9 B8 TPS / AcceptLen | DSpARK-9 B16 TPS / AcceptLen |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GSM8K | **908.50 / 10.0575** | 777.25 / 6.5264 | 772.77 / 8.2839 |
| MATH-500 | **1136.46 / 9.6771** | 953.73 / 6.3776 | 896.42 / 7.6937 |
| AIME25 | **1068.17 / 8.2191** | 895.34 / 5.5752 | 825.63 / 6.5682 |
| HumanEval | **1012.01 / 10.3252** | 866.10 / 6.7083 | 816.02 / 7.9778 |
| MBPP | **966.96 / 9.4212** | 842.98 / 6.3847 | 736.51 / 6.9414 |
| LiveCodeBench | **957.39 / 7.4344** | 812.69 / 5.1157 | 695.51 / 5.5814 |

The released [Tiny](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree#benchmark-results) and [Flash](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree#benchmark-results) model cards also report B16 comparisons against DFlash and DSpARK using acceptance length and end-to-end speedup over target-only decoding. Those results use the model cards' stated benchmark protocol.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code according to the SGLang contribution guide.
- [x] Add kernel and runtime unit tests.
- [x] Update user-facing documentation through the linked model cards and serving commands.
- [x] Provide accuracy test results.
- [x] Provide speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code-style guidance.

+"""Bitwise regression tests for fused UBTree causal-conv + KDA transform."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.linear.fused_kda_conv_tree_transform import (
+    fused_kda_conv_tree_transform,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mamba.causal_conv1d_triton import causal_conv1d_update
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=15, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_tree_transform_kernel(
+    A_log,
+    a,
+    dt_bias,
+    softplus_beta,
+    softplus_threshold,
+    lower_bound,
+    k,
+    v,
+    b,
+    cu_seqlens,
+    processed_k,
+    processed_decay,
+    processed_beta,
+    factor_cache_indices,
+    tree_rawv,
+    tree_rawk,
+    tree_g,
+    tree_beta,
+    stride_rawv_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_rawk_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_g_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_beta_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_a,
+    stride_k,
+    stride_v,
+    stride_b,
+    TREE_WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_TREE_WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    HV: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    V: tl.constexpr,
+    BK: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_QK_L2NORM_IN_KERNEL: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_LOWER_BOUND: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_TREE_FACTORS: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_GDC: tl.constexpr = False,
+):
+    """Precompute node-local transforms once for all descendant factor walks."""
+    i_nt, i_hv = tl.program_id(0), tl.program_id(1)
+    if USE_GDC:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_launch_dependents()
+
+    i_n = i_nt // TREE_WIDTH
+    node_idx = i_nt % TREE_WIDTH
+    i_h = i_hv // (HV // H)
+    bos = tl.load(cu_seqlens + i_n).to(tl.int64)
+    eos = tl.load(cu_seqlens + i_n + 1).to(tl.int64)
+    active = node_idx < eos - bos
+    token_idx = bos + node_idx
+    o_k = tl.arange(0, BK)
+    mask_k = o_k < K
+
+    b_rawk = tl.load(
+        k + token_idx * stride_k + i_h * K + o_k,
+        mask=active & mask_k,
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    b_k = b_rawk
+    if USE_QK_L2NORM_IN_KERNEL:
+        b_k /= tl.sqrt(tl.sum(b_k * b_k) + 1e-6)
+    b_a = tl.load(
+        a + token_idx * stride_a + i_hv * K + o_k,
+        mask=active & mask_k,
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    b_b = tl.load(
+        b + token_idx * stride_b + i_hv,
+        mask=active,
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    b_A_log = tl.load(A_log + i_hv).to(tl.float32)
+    b_dt_bias = tl.load(dt_bias + i_hv * K + o_k, mask=mask_k, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    x = b_a + b_dt_bias
+    if USE_LOWER_BOUND:
+        b_g = lower_bound * tl.sigmoid(tl.exp(b_A_log) * x)
+    else:
+        beta_x = softplus_beta * x
+        softplus_x = tl.where(
+            beta_x <= softplus_threshold,
+            (1.0 / softplus_beta) * tl.log(1.0 + tl.exp(beta_x)),
+            x,
+        )
+        b_g = -tl.exp(b_A_log) * softplus_x
+    b_decay = tl.exp(b_g)
+    b_beta = 1.0 / (1.0 + tl.exp(-b_b))
+
+    transform_base = (i_n * HV * TREE_WIDTH + i_hv * TREE_WIDTH + node_idx) * K
+    tl.store(processed_k + transform_base + o_k, b_k, mask=active & mask_k)
+    tl.store(processed_decay + transform_base + o_k, b_decay, mask=active & mask_k)
+    tl.store(
+        processed_beta + (i_n * HV + i_hv) * TREE_WIDTH + node_idx,
+        b_beta,
+        mask=active,
+    )
+
+    if CACHE_TREE_FACTORS:
+        factor_slot = tl.load(factor_cache_indices + i_n).to(tl.int64)
+        if factor_slot >= 0:
+            b_rawv = tl.load(
+                v + token_idx * stride_v + i_hv * V + o_k,
+                mask=active & mask_k,
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            tl.store(
+                tree_rawv
+                + factor_slot * stride_rawv_slot
+                + (i_hv * CACHE_TREE_WIDTH + node_idx) * V
+                + o_k,
+                b_rawv,
+                mask=active & mask_k,
+            )
+            tl.store(
+                tree_g
+                + factor_slot * stride_g_slot
+                + (i_hv * CACHE_TREE_WIDTH + node_idx) * K
+                + o_k,
+                b_g,
+                mask=active & mask_k,
+            )
+            if i_hv % (HV // H) == 0:
+                tl.store(
+                    tree_rawk
+                    + factor_slot * stride_rawk_slot
+                    + (i_h * CACHE_TREE_WIDTH + node_idx) * K
+                    + o_k,
+                    b_rawk,
+                    mask=active & mask_k,
+                )
+            tl.store(
+                tree_beta
+                + factor_slot * stride_beta_slot
+                + i_hv * CACHE_TREE_WIDTH
+                + node_idx,
+                b_beta,
+                mask=active,
+            )
+
+
+def _outputs(batch, heads, nodes, dim, device):
+    pk = torch.empty(batch, heads, nodes, dim, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    pd = torch.empty_like(pk)
+    pb = torch.empty(batch, heads, nodes, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    rv = torch.empty(batch, heads, nodes, dim, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    rk = torch.empty_like(rv)
+    g = torch.empty(batch, heads, nodes, dim, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    beta = torch.empty(batch, heads, nodes, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    return pk, pd, pb, rv, rk, g, beta
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch", [1])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("heads,nodes", [(8, 32), (16, 49)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("weight_dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("lower_bound", [None, -5.0])
+def test_fused_conv_tree_transform_matches_reference(
+    batch, heads, nodes, weight_dtype, lower_bound

+    torch.manual_seed(20260918 + nodes)
+    device = "cuda"
+    head_dim, cache_nodes = 128, nodes
+    model_dim = 3 * heads * head_dim
+    x = torch.randn(batch, model_dim, nodes, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    weight = torch.randn(model_dim, 4, device=device, dtype=weight_dtype) * 0.1
+    state = torch.randn(batch, model_dim, 3, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    state_indices = torch.arange(batch, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    factor_indices = state_indices.clone()
+    parent_row = [-1] + [(i - 1) // 4 for i in range(1, nodes)]
+    parents = torch.tensor([parent_row] * batch, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    tree_marker = torch.zeros_like(parents)
+    inter_ref = torch.empty(

detail.body:
# [Feat] speculative: Add native UBTree decoding for Ling3

## Motivation

This PR provides native SGLang inference support for the released UBTree draft checkpoints:

- [inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree), paired with [Ling-3.0-tiny](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny).
- [inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree), paired with [Ling-3.0-flash](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash).

UBTree combines a parallel DFlash proposer with a learned bigram selector to build a proposal tree. The target verifies the tree in one forward pass and commits the accepted continuation. The draft checkpoints are used alongside their matching target models and share the target's token embeddings and LM head.

For KDA linear attention, saving a complete recurrent state for every proposal node adds memory traffic and temporary storage. This PR uses a shared pre-tree state and per-node factors, then folds only the accepted path into persistent state. It also includes checkpoint loading, tree construction, and fixed-width CUDA Graph execution in SGLang.

## Modifications

- Native UBTree serving for Ling3 Tiny and Flash: built-in algorithm registration, draft-checkpoint loading, selector caches, tensor-parallel vocabulary top-k, and proposal-tree construction.
- Factorized Triton KDA tree verification using a shared pre-tree recurrent state and root-to-node factors.
- Fused causal convolution and tree transformation to prepare factor-generation inputs with fewer intermediate launches and tensor transfers.
- Accepted-path KDA/convolution-state and target/draft-KV commit through a shared verification epilogue for eager execution and CUDA Graph replay.
- Fixed-width BS=1 full decode CUDA Graph execution covering draft proposals, target verification, and accepted-path commit.
- FA3 tree-verification metadata with a `QLEN_ONLY` visibility mask.
- NVIDIA L20X Triton 3.7.1 MoE forward and down-projection tuning configurations for Ling expert shapes.
- Component, selector, tree-topology, kernel, backend, and CUDA Graph replay regression tests.

## Supported Scope

| Item | Supported configuration |
|---|---|
| Target models | Ling-3.0-tiny and Ling-3.0-flash (`BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM`) |
| Released draft checkpoints | [Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree) and [Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree), both B16 |
| Ling3 Tiny verification | 49 nodes; TP1 startup validated |
| Ling3 Flash verification | 32 nodes; TP4 startup validated |
| Ling3 Flash draft blocks | 8 and 16 exercised during development; the linked release is B16 |
| Scheduling | One active request, greedy decoding, DP=1, PP=1 |
| Linear attention backend | Triton KDA |
| Full attention backend | FA3 for both target and draft, page size 1 |
| CUDA Graph | Fixed-width full decode, BS=1; prefill graphs and graph padding disabled |

**B16 is the draft block size, not the verification-tree width.** Select the runtime verification width with `--speculative-num-draft-tokens`; the current native path supports 32 or 49 nodes within the checkpoint's tree budget.

## Integration Boundary

This PR includes the SGLang runtime support needed to serve the two linked UBTree releases:

- draft-checkpoint loading and selector-cache materialization;
- proposal-node selection and tree construction;
- factorized KDA verification and recurrent-state management;
- accepted-path state and KV commit;
- FA3 tree metadata and CUDA Graph capture/replay.

Model training, checkpoint export, and model weights remain outside SGLang. The native serving path does not require an external Ling-Spec UBTree runtime plugin.

UBTree dispatch uses the built-in algorithm and explicit tree metadata. Backend regression tests cover the existing snapshot path alongside the new tree path.

Launch with `--speculative-algorithm UBTREE` and the matching `--speculative-draft-model-path`. The [Tiny model card](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree#serving-with-sglang) and [Flash model card](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree#serving-with-sglang) provide full launch commands using the PR's [`asahi/ubtree` branch](https://github.com/AsaHIXx/sglang/tree/asahi/ubtree).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

### Test protocol

The table below retains the previously reported PR measurements. Their benchmark revision was not specified in the original description.

| Item | Setting |
|---|---|
| Datasets | GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME25, HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench |
| Model | Ling3 Flash |
| Batch size | 1 |
| Sampling | `temperature=0` |
| Maximum output | `max_new_tokens=2048` |
| EOS | Retained |
| Full attention | FA3 |
| Linear attention | Triton KDA |
| CUDA Graph | Full decode CUDA Graph, fixed BS=1 |
| Settings | UBTree: 32 nodes / B16; DSpARK: 9 nodes / B8 or B16 |
| GPU | 4× NVIDIA L20X |

### Reproduce command

The released [Tiny](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree#benchmark-results) and [Flash](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree#benchmark-results) model cards contain reproduce server commands.

### Results

Each cell shows **tokens/s / average acceptance length**. Acceptance length includes the bonus token.

| Dataset | UBTree-32 B16 TPS / AcceptLen | DSpARK-9 B8 TPS / AcceptLen | DSpARK-9 B16 TPS / AcceptLen |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GSM8K | **908.50 / 10.0575** | 777.25 / 6.5264 | 772.77 / 8.2839 |
| MATH-500 | **1136.46 / 9.6771** | 953.73 / 6.3776 | 896.42 / 7.6937 |
| AIME25 | **1068.17 / 8.2191** | 895.34 / 5.5752 | 825.63 / 6.5682 |
| HumanEval | **1012.01 / 10.3252** | 866.10 / 6.7083 | 816.02 / 7.9778 |
| MBPP | **966.96 / 9.4212** | 842.98 / 6.3847 | 736.51 / 6.9414 |
| LiveCodeBench | **957.39 / 7.4344** | 812.69 / 5.1157 | 695.51 / 5.5814 |

The released [Tiny](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree#benchmark-results) and [Flash](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-UBTree#benchmark-results) model cards also report B16 comparisons against DFlash and DSpARK using acceptance length and end-to-end speedup over target-only decoding. Those results use the model cards' stated benchmark protocol.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code according to the SGLang contribution guide.
- [x] Add kernel and runtime unit tests.
- [x] Update user-facing documentation through the linked model cards and serving commands.
- [x] Provide accuracy test results.
- [x] Provide speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code-style guidance.

Our implementation aims to maximize speed and efficiency and is considered to be among the fastest in open-source LLM engines. ## Summary @@ -18,6 +18,7 @@ SGLang provides several speculative decoding options, including EAGLE-2/EAGLE-3, - [Multi Token Prediction](#multi-token-prediction) - [UNO decoding](#uno-decoding) - [DFlash Decoding](#dflash-decoding) +- [UBTree decoding](#ubtree-decoding) - [Standalone Speculative Decoding (Small Draft Model)](#standalone-speculative-decoding-small-draft-model) - [Speculative Decoding V2 (Overlap Scheduler)](#speculative-decoding-v2-overlap-scheduler) - [Ngram Speculative Decoding](#ngram-speculative-decoding) @@ -551,6 +552,52 @@ print(response.choices[0].message.content) --- +## UBTree decoding + +UBTree adds a trained tree selector to a DFlash draft model. The current integration supports Ling3 (`BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM`) targets on NVIDIA CUDA, with FA3 attention and one running request. Both greedy decoding and FlashInfer sampling are supported. Use a UBTree draft export trained for the exact target checkpoint; a plain DFlash checkpoint does not contain the required selector weights. + +Set `LING_TARGET` and `UBTREE_DRAFT` to your paired checkpoint paths, then launch: + +```bash +SGLANG_PLUGINS=none python -m sglang.launch_server \ + --model-path "$LING_TARGET" \ + --speculative-draft-model-path "$UBTREE_DRAFT" \ + --speculative-algorithm UBTREE \ + --speculative-num-draft-tokens 49 \ + --speculative-draft-attention-backend fa3 \ + --speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant \ + --attention-backend fa3 \ + --linear-attn-verify-backend triton \ + --page-size 1 \ + --max-running-requests 1 \ + --cuda-graph-backend-decode full \ + --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled \ + --cuda-graph-bs-decode 1 \ + --disable-cuda-graph-padding \ + --dtype bfloat16 \ + --trust-remote-code +``` + +`--speculative-num-draft-tokens` sets a fixed number of target verification nodes, including the root. Choose any integer from 2 through the exported `tree_budget + 1`. The default is 49, capped by that budget. The 32- and 49-node configurations have specialized kernel paths; other sizes use general paths. Throughput depends on acceptance length, tree size, model, and hardware, so benchmark your workload when choosing a size. The draft block size comes from the checkpoint. `--speculative-eagle-topk` is an internal tree-metadata setting for UBTree and does not tune proposal breadth. + +Send requests with `temperature=0` or `top_k=1` for greedy decoding. For sampling, use `--sampling-backend flashinfer` (the CUDA default) and set `temperature`, `top_k`, `top_p`, and optionally `min_p` in each request. For example: + +```bash +curl http://localhost:30000/generate \ + -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ + -d '{"text": "Explain how speculative decoding works.", "sampling_params": {"temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 0.95, "top_k": 20, "max_new_tokens": 2048}}' +``` + +UBTree samples the target distribution at every tree node, follows children matching those samples, and returns the first sample without a matching child as the bonus token. Top-k/top-p uses FlashInfer's full-vocabulary joint filter, preserving ties at the cutoff; min-p uses the ordinary sampler's top-k/top-p renormalization path. Do not set `--speculative-use-rejection-sampling` or `--speculative-use-block-verification`. + +Non-greedy requests with `sampling_seed`, `--enable-deterministic-inference`, or a sampling backend other than FlashInfer are rejected before admission. Grammar constraints, logprobs, custom logits processors, sampling penalties, `min_new_tokens>0`, logit bias, watermarking, and hidden-state or sampling-mask outputs remain unsupported. Strict thinking, PD disaggregation/role switching, unified memory, PP>1, DP>1, and DP attention are unsupported. + +The target LM head must use dense FP16, BF16, or FP32 weights. Target-embedding-MLP selectors also require dense target embeddings. This restriction concerns the head and embeddings, rather than the dtype of MoE experts. Helion KDA verify cannot use UBTree's compact state; select Triton. The `nv_cutedsl` verify setting also dispatches Ling tree verification to Triton. + +Online target/draft weight updates are rejected when a target-embedding-MLP selector is bound, because its factor caches depend on both models. Restart with the new checkpoint pair. Lookup selectors do not impose this cache restriction. + +The full draft/proposal CUDA Graph and the separate sampling/commit tail are captured lazily on their first decode use. The sampling tail generates fresh random seeds on every replay and does not recapture the target model. Default server warmup may trigger lazy capture; standard target Graph startup statistics do not include it. Warm up the request's sampling mode before measuring steady-state throughput. To run the same sampling and commit functions eagerly, replace `--cuda-graph-backend-decode full` with `--cuda-graph-backend-decode disabled` and keep prefill Graphs disabled. Greedy decoding does not imply bitwise logit or token parity with a separately executed autoregressive baseline. + ## DFlash Decoding SGLang also supports **DFLASH** speculative decoding using a dedicated draft model checkpoint. Compared with EAGLE-style tree verification, DFLASH verifies a linear draft block and is configured around a block size / draft window. +"""Fused UBTree causal-conv and KDA node transform.
+
+The production path is restricted to BS=1, 32/49 verify nodes, convolution
+width 4, H == HV, and K == V. It replaces the tree causal-conv launch plus
+``fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_tree_transform_kernel`` while preserving the
+materialized post-conv Q/K/V tensor consumed by factor generation.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fused_kda_conv_tree_transform_kernel(
+    x,
+    conv_weight,
+    conv_bias,
+    conv_state,
+    conv_state_indices,
+    intermediate_conv_window,
+    factor_cache_indices,
+    retrieve_parent_token,
+    a,
+    b,
+    A_log,
+    dt_bias,
+    out,
+    processed_k,
+    processed_decay,
+    processed_beta,
+    tree_rawv,
+    tree_rawk,
+    tree_g,
+    tree_beta,
+    stride_x_batch: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_x_dim: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_x_token: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_state_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_state_dim: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_state_win: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_inter_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_inter_step: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_inter_dim: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_inter_win: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_parent_batch: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_parent_token: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_a_token: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_b_token: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_out_batch: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_out_dim: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_out_token: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_rawv_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_rawk_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_g_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_beta_slot: tl.constexpr,
+    SOFTPLUS_BETA: tl.constexpr,
+    SOFTPLUS_THRESHOLD: tl.constexpr,
+    LOWER_BOUND: tl.constexpr,
+    TREE_WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_TREE_WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    HV: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    BK: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_LOWER_BOUND: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_TREE_FACTORS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    batch = tl.program_id(0)
+    node = tl.program_id(1)
+    hv = tl.program_id(2)
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, BK)
+    mask = offsets < K
+    state_slot = tl.load(conv_state_indices + batch).to(tl.int64)
+    factor_slot = tl.load(factor_cache_indices + batch).to(tl.int64)
+
+    q_dim_base = hv * K
+    k_dim_base = HV * K + hv * K
+    v_dim_base = 2 * HV * K + hv * K
+    current = node.to(tl.int64)
+
+    if HAS_BIAS:
+        acc_q = tl.load(conv_bias + q_dim_base + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        )
+        acc_k = tl.load(conv_bias + k_dim_base + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        )
+        acc_v = tl.load(conv_bias + v_dim_base + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        )
+    else:
+        acc_q = tl.zeros((BK,), dtype=tl.float32)
+        acc_k = tl.zeros((BK,), dtype=tl.float32)
+        acc_v = tl.zeros((BK,), dtype=tl.float32)
+
+    # Preserve the node-local raw input used by accept-path conv commit.
+    raw_q = tl.load(
+        x
+        + batch * stride_x_batch
+        + (q_dim_base + offsets) * stride_x_dim
+        + node * stride_x_token,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    raw_k_input = tl.load(
+        x
+        + batch * stride_x_batch
+        + (k_dim_base + offsets) * stride_x_dim
+        + node * stride_x_token,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    raw_v_input = tl.load(
+        x
+        + batch * stride_x_batch
+        + (v_dim_base + offsets) * stride_x_dim
+        + node * stride_x_token,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    inter_base = (
+        intermediate_conv_window
+        + factor_slot * stride_inter_slot
+        + node * stride_inter_step
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        inter_base + (q_dim_base + offsets) * stride_inter_dim + 2 * stride_inter_win,
+        raw_q,
+        mask=mask & (factor_slot >= 0),
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        inter_base + (k_dim_base + offsets) * stride_inter_dim + 2 * stride_inter_win,
+        raw_k_input,
+        mask=mask & (factor_slot >= 0),
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        inter_base + (v_dim_base + offsets) * stride_inter_dim + 2 * stride_inter_win,
+        raw_v_input,
+        mask=mask & (factor_slot >= 0),
+    )
+
+    value_q = raw_q
+    value_k = raw_k_input
+    value_v = raw_v_input
+    for tap in tl.static_range(4):
+        weight_col = 3 - tap
+        wq = tl.load(
+            conv_weight + (q_dim_base + offsets) * 4 + weight_col, mask=mask, other=0.0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        wk = tl.load(
+            conv_weight + (k_dim_base + offsets) * 4 + weight_col, mask=mask, other=0.0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        wv = tl.load(
+            conv_weight + (v_dim_base + offsets) * 4 + weight_col, mask=mask, other=0.0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        acc_q += value_q.to(tl.float32) * wq
+        acc_k += value_k.to(tl.float32) * wk
+        acc_v += value_v.to(tl.float32) * wv
+
+        if tap < 3:
+            # Keep the ancestor walk branch-free.  ``current > 0`` means the
+            # next value comes from a tree node; ``current <= 0`` encodes the
+            # persistent conv-state columns 2, 1, 0.  Triton runtime branches
+            # around a loop-carried scalar produced incorrect SSA merges for
+            # sibling programs, while masked loads + tl.where are deterministic.
+            use_tree_node = current > 0
+            safe_node = tl.maximum(current, 0)
+            parent = tl.load(
+                retrieve_parent_token
+                + batch * stride_parent_batch
+                + safe_node * stride_parent_token
+            ).to(tl.int64)
+            history = tl.maximum(0, tl.minimum(2, 2 + current))
+
+            tree_q = tl.load(
+                x
+                + batch * stride_x_batch
+                + (q_dim_base + offsets) * stride_x_dim
+                + parent * stride_x_token,
+                mask=mask & use_tree_node,
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            tree_k = tl.load(
+                x
+                + batch * stride_x_batch
+                + (k_dim_base + offsets) * stride_x_dim
+                + parent * stride_x_token,
+                mask=mask & use_tree_node,
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            tree_v = tl.load(
+                x
+                + batch * stride_x_batch
+                + (v_dim_base + offsets) * stride_x_dim
+                + parent * stride_x_token,
+                mask=mask & use_tree_node,
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            state_q = tl.load(
+                conv_state
+                + state_slot * stride_state_slot
+                + (q_dim_base + offsets) * stride_state_dim
+                + history * stride_state_win,
+                mask=mask & (~use_tree_node) & (state_slot >= 0),
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            state_k = tl.load(
+                conv_state
+                + state_slot * stride_state_slot
+                + (k_dim_base + offsets) * stride_state_dim
+                + history * stride_state_win,
+                mask=mask & (~use_tree_node) & (state_slot >= 0),
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            state_v = tl.load(
+                conv_state
+                + state_slot * stride_state_slot
+                + (v_dim_base + offsets) * stride_state_dim
+                + history * stride_state_win,
+                mask=mask & (~use_tree_node) & (state_slot >= 0),
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            value_q = tl.where(use_tree_node, tree_q, state_q)
+            value_k = tl.where(use_tree_node, tree_k, state_k)
+            value_v = tl.where(use_tree_node, tree_v, state_v)
+            current = tl.where(use_tree_node, parent, current - 1)
+
+    # Match the two-kernel reference boundary: causal-conv stores BF16, then
+    # the transform kernel reloads and promotes that rounded value to FP32.
+    q_conv = (acc_q * tl.sigmoid(acc_q)).to(out.dtype.element_ty)
+    k_conv = (acc_k * tl.sigmoid(acc_k)).to(out.dtype.element_ty)
+    v_conv = (acc_v * tl.sigmoid(acc_v)).to(out.dtype.element_ty)
+    tl.store(
+        out
+        + batch * stride_out_batch
+        + (q_dim_base + offsets) * stride_out_dim
+        + node * stride_out_token,
+        q_conv,
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        out
+        + batch * stride_out_batch
+        + (k_dim_base + offsets) * stride_out_dim
+        + node * stride_out_token,
+        k_conv,
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        out
+        + batch * stride_out_batch
+        + (v_dim_base + offsets) * stride_out_dim
+        + node * stride_out_token,
+        v_conv,
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+
+    raw_k_conv = k_conv.to(tl.float32)
+    k_conv_fp32 = k_conv.to(tl.float32)
+    v_conv_fp32 = v_conv.to(tl.float32)
+    norm = tl.sqrt(tl.sum(k_conv_fp32 * k_conv_fp32, axis=0) + 1e-6)
+    k_norm = k_conv_fp32 / norm
+    token = batch * TREE_WIDTH + node
+    a_value = tl.load(
+        a + token * stride_a_token + hv * K + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    b_value = tl.load(b + token * stride_b_token + hv).to(tl.float32)
+    a_log = tl.load(A_log + hv).to(tl.float32)
+    dt = tl.load(dt_bias + hv * K + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    gate_input = a_value + dt
+    if USE_LOWER_BOUND:
+        g = LOWER_BOUND * tl.sigmoid(tl.exp(a_log) * gate_input)
+    else:
+        beta_x = SOFTPLUS_BETA * gate_input
+        softplus_x = tl.where(
+            beta_x <= SOFTPLUS_THRESHOLD,
+            tl.log(1.0 + tl.exp(beta_x)) / SOFTPLUS_BETA,
+            gate_input,
+        )
+        g = -tl.exp(a_log) * softplus_x
+    decay = tl.exp(g)
+    beta = tl.sigmoid(b_value)
+
+    transform_base = ((batch * HV + hv) * TREE_WIDTH + node) * K
+    tl.store(processed_k + transform_base + offsets, k_norm, mask=mask)
+    tl.store(processed_decay + transform_base + offsets, decay, mask=mask)
+    tl.store(processed_beta + (batch * HV + hv) * TREE_WIDTH + node, beta)
+
+    if CACHE_TREE_FACTORS:
+        cache_mask = mask & (factor_slot >= 0)
+        tl.store(
+            tree_rawv
+            + factor_slot * stride_rawv_slot
+            + (hv * CACHE_TREE_WIDTH + node) * K
+            + offsets,
+            v_conv_fp32,
+            mask=cache_mask,
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            tree_rawk
+            + factor_slot * stride_rawk_slot
+            + (hv * CACHE_TREE_WIDTH + node) * K
+            + offsets,
+            raw_k_conv,
+            mask=cache_mask,
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            tree_g
+            + factor_slot * stride_g_slot
+            + (hv * CACHE_TREE_WIDTH + node) * K
+            + offsets,
+            g,
+            mask=cache_mask,
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            tree_beta + factor_slot * stride_beta_slot + hv * CACHE_TREE_WIDTH + node,
+            beta,
+            mask=factor_slot >= 0,
+        )
+
+
+def fused_kda_conv_tree_transform(
+    *,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    conv_state: torch.Tensor,
+    conv_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    conv_bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+    conv_state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    intermediate_conv_window: torch.Tensor,
+    retrieve_parent_token: torch.Tensor,
+    a: torch.Tensor,
+    b: torch.Tensor,
+    A_log: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    processed_k: torch.Tensor,
+    processed_decay: torch.Tensor,
+    processed_beta: torch.Tensor,

+def _prepare_draft_commit_kernel(
+    seq_lens,
+    req_pool_indices,
+    req_to_token,
+    positions_out,
+    cache_loc_out,
+    req_to_token_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    positions_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    cache_loc_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    width: tl.constexpr,
+    block_size: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    columns = tl.arange(0, block_size)
+    valid = columns < width
+
+    seq_len = tl.load(seq_lens + row).to(tl.int64)
+    req_pool_index = tl.load(req_pool_indices + row).to(tl.int64)
+    positions = seq_len + columns
+    cache_locs = tl.load(
+        req_to_token + req_pool_index * req_to_token_stride_row + positions,
+        mask=valid,
+        other=0,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+
+    tl.store(
+        positions_out + row * positions_stride_row + columns,
+        positions,
+        mask=valid,

+        cache_loc_out + row * cache_loc_stride_row + columns,
+        cache_locs,
+        mask=valid,
+    )

+def prepare_draft_commit_metadata(
+    *,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
+    positions_out: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_loc_out: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """Fill dense positions/cache locations without allocating temporary tensors.
+
+    For each request ``b`` and commit slot ``i`` this writes::
+
+        positions_out[b, i] = seq_lens[b] + i
+        cache_loc_out[b, i] = req_to_token[req_pool_indices[b], positions_out[b, i]]
+
+    The output tensors are caller-owned so their addresses can remain stable across
+    decode steps and can later be consumed by a larger CUDA Graph region.
+    """
+
+    if seq_lens.ndim != 1 or req_pool_indices.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError("seq_lens and req_pool_indices must be one-dimensional")
+    batch_size = int(seq_lens.numel())
+    if int(req_pool_indices.numel()) != batch_size:
+        raise ValueError("req_pool_indices must contain one index per request")
+    if positions_out.ndim != 2 or cache_loc_out.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("positions_out and cache_loc_out must be two-dimensional")
+    if positions_out.shape != cache_loc_out.shape:
+        raise ValueError("positions_out and cache_loc_out must have matching shapes")
+    if int(positions_out.shape[0]) != batch_size:
+        raise ValueError("output batch dimension must match seq_lens")
+    if positions_out.dtype != torch.int64 or cache_loc_out.dtype != torch.int64:
+        raise ValueError("positions_out and cache_loc_out must use torch.int64")
+    if not positions_out.is_contiguous() or not cache_loc_out.is_contiguous():
+        raise ValueError("positions_out and cache_loc_out must be contiguous")

+        raise ValueError("req_to_token must be two-dimensional")

+        seq_lens.device
+        == req_pool_indices.device
+        == req_to_token.device
+        == positions_out.device
+        == cache_loc_out.device

+        raise ValueError("all draft commit metadata tensors must use the same device")
+
+    width = int(positions_out.shape[1])
+    if batch_size == 0 or width == 0:
+        return

+            seq_lens,
+            req_pool_indices,
+            req_to_token,
+            positions_out,
+            cache_loc_out,

+            positions_stride_row=positions_out.stride(0),
+            cache_loc_stride_row=cache_loc_out.stride(0),

+            block_size=block_size,

+        req_to_token[req_pool_indices.to(torch.int64)],
+        1,
+        positions_out,
+        out=cache_loc_out,
+    )

+    req_to_token,
+    seq_lens,
+    accept_index,
+    accept_lens,
+    out_cache_loc,
+    target_cache_loc_out,
+    source_cache_loc_out,
+    req_to_token_stride_row: tl.constexpr,

+        req_to_token,
+        seq_lens,
+        accept_index,
+        accept_lens,

+        target_cache_loc_out,
+        source_cache_loc_out,

+@triton.jit
+def _prepare_unified_commit_metadata_kernel(
+    req_pool_indices,
+    target_req_to_token,
+    draft_req_to_token,
+    seq_lens,
+    accept_index,
+    accept_lens,
+    out_cache_loc,
+    target_cache_loc_out,
+    source_cache_loc_out,
+    draft_positions_out,
+    draft_cache_loc_out,
+    target_req_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    draft_req_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    accept_index_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    target_out_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    source_out_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    draft_positions_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    draft_cache_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    width: tl.constexpr,
+    block_size: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Emit target-move and draft-commit layouts from one logical path map."""
+
+    request_index = tl.program_id(0)
+    columns = tl.arange(0, block_size)
+    in_width = columns < width
+
+    seq_len = tl.load(seq_lens + request_index).to(tl.int64)
+    req_pool_index = tl.load(req_pool_indices + request_index).to(tl.int64)
+    positions = seq_len + columns
+
+    target_cache_locs = tl.load(
+        target_req_to_token + req_pool_index * target_req_stride_row + positions,
+        mask=in_width,
+        other=0,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+    draft_cache_locs = tl.load(
+        draft_req_to_token + req_pool_index * draft_req_stride_row + positions,
+        mask=in_width,
+        other=0,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+
+    accept_len = tl.load(accept_lens + request_index).to(tl.int32)
+    accepted = in_width & (columns < accept_len)
+    accept_node_index = tl.load(
+        accept_index + request_index * accept_index_stride_row + columns,
+        mask=accepted,
+        other=-1,
+    ).to(tl.int64)

+        out_cache_loc + accept_node_index,
+        mask=accepted & (accept_node_index >= 0),
+        other=0,

+    source_offsets = request_index * source_out_stride_row + columns
+    draft_position_offsets = request_index * draft_positions_stride_row + columns
+    draft_cache_offsets = request_index * draft_cache_stride_row + columns

+        target_cache_loc_out + target_offsets,
+        tl.where(accepted, target_cache_locs, 0),
+        mask=in_width,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        source_cache_loc_out + source_offsets,
+        source_cache_locs,
+        mask=in_width,
+    )
+    tl.store(draft_positions_out + draft_position_offsets, positions, mask=in_width)

+def prepare_unified_commit_metadata(
+    *,
+    req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    target_req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    accept_index: torch.Tensor,
+    accept_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    out_cache_loc: torch.Tensor,
+    target_cache_loc_out: torch.Tensor,
+    source_cache_loc_out: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_positions_out: torch.Tensor,
+    draft_cache_loc_out: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """Build all accepted-path commit layouts in one pass.
+
+    The shared logical mapping is ``(request_index, accept_column)``. Target
+    movement derives its source from the accepted tree node and its destination
+    from the target request table. Draft injection uses the same sequence
+    position but resolves it through the draft request table. Target movement is
+    stored as a request-major dense layout; rejected tail slots are ``0 -> 0``.
+    """

+    if accept_index.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("accept_index must be two-dimensional")
+    batch_size, width = map(int, accept_index.shape)
+    if any(
+        int(tensor.numel()) != batch_size
+        for tensor in (req_pool_indices, seq_lens, accept_lens)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("request metadata must contain one value per request")
+    if target_req_to_token.ndim != 2 or draft_req_to_token.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("request-to-token tables must be two-dimensional")

+        target_cache_loc_out,
+        source_cache_loc_out,
+        draft_positions_out,
+        draft_cache_loc_out,
+    )
+    if any(tensor.ndim != 2 for tensor in outputs):
+        raise ValueError("unified commit outputs must be two-dimensional")
+    expected_shape = (batch_size, width)
+    if any(tuple(tensor.shape) != expected_shape for tensor in outputs):
+        raise ValueError(f"unified commit outputs must have shape {expected_shape}")
+    if any(tensor.dtype != torch.int64 for tensor in outputs):
+        raise ValueError("unified commit outputs must use torch.int64")
+    if any(not tensor.is_contiguous() for tensor in outputs):
+        raise ValueError("unified commit outputs must be contiguous")
+    tensors = (
+        req_pool_indices,
+        target_req_to_token,
+        draft_req_to_token,
+        seq_lens,
+        accept_index,
+        accept_lens,
+        out_cache_loc,
+        *outputs,
+    )
+    if any(tensor.device != seq_lens.device for tensor in tensors):
+        raise ValueError("all unified commit tensors must use the same device")
+    if batch_size == 0 or width == 0:
+        return
+
+    if seq_lens.device.type == "cuda":
+        block_size = triton.next_power_of_2(width)
+        _prepare_unified_commit_metadata_kernel[(batch_size,)](
+            req_pool_indices,
+            target_req_to_token,
+            draft_req_to_token,
+            seq_lens,
+            accept_index,
+            accept_lens,
+            out_cache_loc,
+            target_cache_loc_out,
+            source_cache_loc_out,
+            draft_positions_out,
+            draft_cache_loc_out,
+            target_req_stride_row=target_req_to_token.stride(0),
+            draft_req_stride_row=draft_req_to_token.stride(0),
+            accept_index_stride_row=accept_index.stride(0),
+            target_out_stride_row=target_cache_loc_out.stride(0),
+            source_out_stride_row=source_cache_loc_out.stride(0),
+            draft_positions_stride_row=draft_positions_out.stride(0),
+            draft_cache_stride_row=draft_cache_loc_out.stride(0),
+            width=width,
+            block_size=block_size,
+        )
+        return
+
+    offsets = torch.arange(width, dtype=torch.int64, device=seq_lens.device)
+    torch.add(seq_lens.to(torch.int64).unsqueeze(1), offsets, out=draft_positions_out)
+    request_rows = req_pool_indices.to(torch.int64)
+    torch.gather(
+        draft_req_to_token[request_rows],
+        1,
+        draft_positions_out,
+        out=draft_cache_loc_out,
+    )
+    torch.gather(
+        target_req_to_token[request_rows],
+        1,
+        draft_positions_out,
+        out=target_cache_loc_out,
+    )
+    accepted = offsets.unsqueeze(0) < accept_lens.to(torch.int64).unsqueeze(1)
+    target_cache_loc_out.masked_fill_(~accepted, 0)
+    source_cache_loc_out.zero_()
+    safe_accept_index = accept_index.to(torch.int64).clamp_min(0)
+    gathered_source = out_cache_loc[safe_accept_index]
+    source_cache_loc_out.copy_(torch.where(accepted, gathered_source, 0))

+"""Shared eligibility and scratch sizing for UBTree's compact KDA state."""
+
+from math import prod
+
+from sglang.srt.configs.mamba_utils import BaseLinearStateParams
+from sglang.srt.platforms import current_platform
+
+
+def use_ubtree_factorized_kda(
+    *,
+    enabled: bool,
+    cache_params: BaseLinearStateParams,
+    spec_state_size: int,
+    speculative_num_draft_tokens: int | None,
+    speculative_eagle_topk: int | None,
+) -> bool:
+    return bool(
+        enabled
+        and current_platform.is_cuda()
+        and spec_state_size == 1
+        and cache_params.is_kda
+        and speculative_eagle_topk is not None
+        and speculative_eagle_topk > 1
+        and speculative_num_draft_tokens is not None
+        and speculative_num_draft_tokens >= 2
+    )
+
+
+def ubtree_spec_state_bytes_per_req(
+    cache_params: BaseLinearStateParams, num_draft_tokens: int
+) -> int:
+    """Raw v/k/g/beta plus dense conv windows, across all KDA layers.
+
+    The caller supplies the active request count plus the pool's padding slot;
+    persistent temporal/conv states are budgeted separately.
+    """
+    hv, v_dim, k_dim = cache_params.shape.temporal
+    h_k = cache_params.shape.num_k_heads_per_tp
+    activation_bytes = cache_params.dtype.conv.itemsize
+    per_node = (
+        (hv * v_dim + h_k * k_dim) * activation_bytes  # raw v/k
+        + hv * (k_dim + 1) * 4  # fp32 g/beta
+        + sum(prod(shape) for shape in cache_params.shape.conv) * activation_bytes
+    )
+    return per_node * num_draft_tokens * len(cache_params.layers)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+# Copyright (c) 2026 The DeepSpec Authors
+# See LICENSE in this directory for the original license.
+
+"""Configuration contract shared by the UBTree exporter and runtime."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class UBTreeConfig:
+    block_size: int
+    candidate_k: int
+    tree_budget: int
+    supertree_width: int
+    rank: int
+    depth_bonus: float
+    factorizer_hidden_width: int
+    target_embedding_dim: int
+    depth_count: int
+    token_factorizer: str
+
+    @property
+    def verify_node_count(self) -> int:
+        return self.tree_budget + 1
+
+
+def _mapping(value: Any) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return value
+    if value is None:
+        return {}
+    if hasattr(value, "to_dict"):
+        return value.to_dict()
+    return vars(value)
+
+
+def parse_ubtree_config(config: Any) -> UBTreeConfig:
+    """Parse and validate the serving subset of a DeepSpec UBTree config."""
+
+    root = _mapping(config)
+    metadata = _mapping(
+        root.get("ubtree_config", getattr(config, "ubtree_config", None))
+    )
+    dflash = _mapping(root.get("dflash_config", getattr(config, "dflash_config", None)))
+
+    block_size = int(
+        root.get("block_size", getattr(config, "block_size", 0))
+        or dflash.get("block_size", 0)
+    )
+    parsed = UBTreeConfig(
+        block_size=block_size,
+        candidate_k=int(metadata.get("candidate_k", 0)),
+        tree_budget=int(metadata.get("tree_budget", 0)),
+        supertree_width=int(metadata.get("tree_supertree_width", 0)),
+        rank=int(metadata.get("rank", 0)),
+        depth_bonus=float(metadata.get("tree_depth_bonus", 0.0)),
+        factorizer_hidden_width=int(metadata.get("factorizer_hidden_width", 0)),
+        target_embedding_dim=int(
+            metadata.get(
+                "target_embedding_dim",
+                root.get("hidden_size", getattr(config, "hidden_size", 0)),
+            )
+        ),
+        depth_count=int(metadata.get("depth_condition_count", 0)),
+        token_factorizer=str(metadata.get("token_factorizer", "target_embedding_mlp")),
+    )
+    positive = {
+        "block_size": parsed.block_size,
+        "candidate_k": parsed.candidate_k,
+        "tree_budget": parsed.tree_budget,
+        "tree_supertree_width": parsed.supertree_width,
+        "rank": parsed.rank,
+    }
+    if parsed.token_factorizer == "target_embedding_mlp":
+        positive.update(
+            factorizer_hidden_width=parsed.factorizer_hidden_width,
+            target_embedding_dim=parsed.target_embedding_dim,
+        )
+    invalid = {name: value for name, value in positive.items() if value <= 0}
+    if invalid:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid UBTree configuration values: {invalid}")
+    if parsed.block_size < 2:
+        raise ValueError("UBTree block_size must be at least 2")
+    if parsed.depth_count != parsed.block_size - 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "UBTree depth_condition_count must equal block_size - 1, got "
+            f"{parsed.depth_count} and {parsed.block_size}"
+        )
+    if parsed.supertree_width > parsed.candidate_k:
+        raise ValueError("UBTree tree_supertree_width cannot exceed candidate_k")
+    if parsed.tree_budget > parsed.depth_count * parsed.supertree_width:
+        raise ValueError("UBTree tree_budget exceeds the generated supertree")
+    if parsed.depth_bonus > 0:
+        raise ValueError("UBTree tree_depth_bonus must be non-positive")
+    if metadata.get("objective") != "kl" or not metadata.get("adds_unary_logits"):
+        raise ValueError("UBTree serving requires the trained S1/S3 KL selector")
+    if parsed.token_factorizer not in {"lookup", "target_embedding_mlp"}:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "UBTree serving requires token_factorizer to be lookup or "
+            "target_embedding_mlp"
+        )
+    if metadata.get("hidden_projection_type", "shared") != "shared":
+        raise ValueError(
+            "The initial SGLang UBTree path supports shared projection only"
+        )
+    return parsed
+
+
+def resolve_verify_width(config: UBTreeConfig, requested: int | None) -> int:
+    """Select one fixed KDA verification shape for the process lifetime."""
+    # Keep the existing default for larger exports without restricting explicit
+    # widths to the shapes with tuned kernels.
+    width = min(49, config.verify_node_count) if requested is None else requested
+    if not 2 <= width <= config.verify_node_count:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "UBTREE --speculative-num-draft-tokens must be at least 2 and fit "
+            f"the checkpoint tree budget ({config.verify_node_count} nodes), got {width}"
+        )
+    return width
+
+
+def validate_runtime_config(cfg, target_backends: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
+    """Validate the fixed-width, single-request Ling serving contract."""
+    if not cfg.device.startswith("cuda"):
+        raise ValueError("UBTREE currently requires a CUDA device")
+    if cfg.pp_size != 1 or cfg.dp_size != 1:
+        raise ValueError("UBTREE currently requires --pp-size 1 and --dp-size 1")
+    if cfg.max_running_requests != 1:
+        raise ValueError("UBTREE currently requires --max-running-requests 1")
+    if cfg.disaggregation_mode != "null" or cfg.enable_pd_role_switch:
+        raise ValueError("UBTREE does not support PD disaggregation or role switching")
+    # nv_cutedsl dispatches Ling KDA tree verify to Triton. Helion only supports
+    # per-node state snapshots, not UBTree's compact factor caches.
+    if cfg.linear_attn_verify_backend not in (None, "triton", "nv_cutedsl"):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "UBTREE factorized KDA verification requires "
+            "--linear-attn-verify-backend triton (nv_cutedsl also falls back to Triton)"
+        )
+    if cfg.enable_strict_thinking:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "UBTREE does not support --enable-strict-thinking because it requires "
+            "grammar decoding"
+        )
+    if cfg.speculative_draft_window_size is not None:
+        raise ValueError("UBTREE does not support --speculative-draft-window-size")
+    if cfg.speculative_draft_sink_size is not None:
+        raise ValueError("UBTREE does not support --speculative-draft-sink-size")
+    if cfg.speculative_use_rejection_sampling or cfg.speculative_use_block_verification:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "UBTREE samples target tokens directly; --speculative-use-rejection-sampling "
+            "and --speculative-use-block-verification are unsupported"
+        )
+    if cfg.speculative_adaptive:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "UBTREE requires a fixed verify width; adaptive steps are unsupported"
+        )
+    if not target_backends or set(target_backends) != {"fa3"}:
+        raise ValueError("UBTREE target attention requires FA3")
+    if cfg.speculative_draft_attention_backend != "fa3":
+        raise ValueError("UBTREE draft attention requires FA3")
+    if cfg.page_size != 1:
+        raise ValueError("UBTREE with FA3 requires --page-size 1")
+    decode = str(cfg.cuda_graph_config.decode.backend).lower()
+    # Phase backends are authoritative. A deprecated disable flag may coexist
+    # with an explicitly selected full backend after argument resolution.
+    if "disabled" not in decode:
+        if "full" not in decode:
+            raise ValueError("UBTREE requires full decode CUDA Graphs")
+        if "disabled" not in str(cfg.cuda_graph_config.prefill.backend).lower():
+            raise ValueError("UBTREE requires --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled")
+        if not cfg.disable_cuda_graph_padding:
+            raise ValueError("UBTREE requires --disable-cuda-graph-padding")
+        if tuple(cfg.cuda_graph_config.decode.bs or ()) != (1,):
+            raise ValueError("UBTREE requires --cuda-graph-bs-decode 1")

+"""Full CUDA Graph replay of the UBTree draft and proposal tail."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from copy import copy
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Iterable
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import graph_capture
+from sglang.srt.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessorOutput
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import ForwardContext, forward_context
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_utils.pool import (
+    get_or_create_global_graph_capture_stream,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.dflash import DFlashDraftModel
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _CapturedFullDraftBucket:
+    input_ids: torch.Tensor
+    positions: torch.Tensor
+    out_cache_loc: torch.Tensor
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor
+    req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor
+    forward_batch: object
+    graph: torch.cuda.CUDAGraph
+    output: LogitsProcessorOutput | None
+    tail_output: object | None
+
+
+class UBTreeDraftSegmentGraphRunner:
+    """Capture the DFlash backbone for exact decode batch sizes."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        model,
+        input_embedding,
+        attn_backend,
+        batch_sizes: Iterable[int],
+        block_size: int,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        device: torch.device | str,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.model = model
+        self.input_embedding = input_embedding
+        self.attn_backend = attn_backend
+        self.block_size = int(block_size)
+        self.hidden_size = int(hidden_size)
+        self.device = torch.device(device)
+        self._full_captured: dict[int, _CapturedFullDraftBucket] = {}
+        self._requested_batch_sizes = tuple(
+            sorted({int(bs) for bs in batch_sizes if int(bs) > 0})
+        )
+        self._capture_tail = None
+
+    @property
+    def batch_sizes(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        return self._requested_batch_sizes
+
+    def attach_capture_tail(self, capture_tail) -> None:
+        """Attach fixed-shape work to the full draft CUDA Graph tail.
+
+        The callback receives the draft model output, graph-owned input ids, and
+        captured forward batch. Its tensor output remains owned by the graph and
+        is refreshed on every replay. Attach it before the first full capture.
+        """
+
+        if self._full_captured:
+            raise RuntimeError("draft capture tail must be attached before capture")
+        self._capture_tail = capture_tail
+
+    def tail_output(self, batch_size: int):
+        captured = self._full_captured.get(int(batch_size))
+        return None if captured is None else captured.tail_output
+
+    def can_run(self, batch_size: int) -> bool:
+        return int(batch_size) in self._requested_batch_sizes
+
+    def _run_full_model(self, captured, forward_batch):
+        self.attn_backend.init_forward_metadata_in_graph(forward_batch)
+        input_hidden = self.input_embedding(captured.input_ids).reshape(
+            captured.input_ids.numel(), self.hidden_size
+        )
+        output = DFlashDraftModel.forward(
+            self.model,
+            input_ids=captured.input_ids,
+            positions=captured.positions,
+            forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            input_embeds=input_hidden,
+        )
+        if self._capture_tail is not None:
+            captured.tail_output = self._capture_tail(
+                output, captured.input_ids, forward_batch
+            )
+        return output
+
+    def _capture_full(
+        self, *, input_ids, positions, forward_batch
+    ) -> _CapturedFullDraftBucket:
+        batch_size = int(forward_batch.batch_size)
+        rows = batch_size * self.block_size
+        captured_input_ids = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
+        captured_positions = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
+        out_cache_loc = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
+        captured_input_ids.copy_(input_ids)
+        captured_positions.copy_(positions)
+        out_cache_loc.copy_(forward_batch.out_cache_loc)
+        seq_lens = forward_batch.seq_lens.clone()
+        req_pool_indices = forward_batch.req_pool_indices.clone()
+
+        captured_forward_batch = copy(forward_batch)
+        captured_forward_batch.input_ids = captured_input_ids
+        captured_forward_batch.positions = captured_positions
+        captured_forward_batch.out_cache_loc = out_cache_loc
+        captured_forward_batch.seq_lens = seq_lens
+        captured_forward_batch.req_pool_indices = req_pool_indices
+        captured_forward_batch.input_embeds = None
+
+        placeholder = _CapturedFullDraftBucket(
+            input_ids=captured_input_ids,
+            positions=captured_positions,
+            out_cache_loc=out_cache_loc,
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            req_pool_indices=req_pool_indices,
+            forward_batch=captured_forward_batch,
+            graph=torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(),
+            output=None,
+            tail_output=None,
+        )

+
+"""Full-vocabulary target sampling and graph-safe UBTree path commits."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import graph_capture
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_utils.pool import (
+    get_or_create_global_graph_capture_stream,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.ubtree_components.epilogue import (
+    UBTreeVerifyEpilogue,
+    UBTreeVerifyResult,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils.async_probe import sanitize_nan_logits
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+    from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_batch_info import SamplingBatchInfo
+
+
+def _sample_target_tokens(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    sampling_info,
+    node_count: int,
+    seed: torch.Tensor,
+    offset: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Use the ordinary FlashInfer AR sampler for every verification node.
+
+    Keep the full vocabulary, including probability ties at the top-k cutoff.
+    Joint top-k/top-p filtering differs from applying top-p after top-k
+    renormalization. The min-p branch follows AR's separate renormalization
+    path instead.
+    """
+    from flashinfer.sampling import (
+        min_p_sampling_from_probs,
+        top_k_top_p_sampling_from_probs,
+    )
+    from sgl_kernel import top_k_renorm_prob, top_p_renorm_prob
+
+    # UBTree admission currently restricts serving to one running request.
+    probs = torch.softmax(logits / sampling_info.temperatures, dim=-1)
+    top_ks = torch.repeat_interleave(sampling_info.top_ks, node_count, dim=0)
+    top_ps = torch.repeat_interleave(sampling_info.top_ps, node_count, dim=0)
+    if sampling_info.need_min_p_sampling:
+        probs = top_k_renorm_prob(probs, top_ks)
+        probs = top_p_renorm_prob(probs, top_ps)
+        min_ps = torch.repeat_interleave(sampling_info.min_ps, node_count, dim=0)
+        target_predict = min_p_sampling_from_probs(
+            probs, min_ps, seed=seed, offset=offset
+        )
+    else:
+        target_predict = top_k_top_p_sampling_from_probs(
+            probs, top_ks, top_ps, filter_apply_order="joint", seed=seed, offset=offset
+        )
+    # FlashInfer returns int32; the tree-walk kernel consumes int64 tokens.
+    return target_predict.to(torch.int64).view(1, node_count)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _CapturedSamplingGraph:
+    graph: torch.cuda.CUDAGraph
+    # Retain the external model outputs and target Graph metadata whose
+    # addresses the tail captured, as well as its private sampling buffers.
+    inputs: tuple
+    sampling_info: SimpleNamespace
+    target_predict: torch.Tensor
+    # A later prefill may replace the materializer's current workspace. Keep
+    # this tail's captured storage alive independently of the target Graph.
+    draft_kv_workspaces: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]
+
+
+class UBTreeSamplingGraphRunner:
+    """Sample, verify, compact, and commit without recapturing the target.
+
+    With model CUDA Graphs disabled, the same sampling and epilogue functions
+    run eagerly. Sampling supports the unseeded FlashInfer backend; request
+    seeds and deterministic sampling are rejected before admission.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, device: torch.device | str) -> None:
+        self.device = torch.device(device)
+        # Lazy capture can run after a different device becomes current.
+        # Keep streams and generators on the worker's concrete CUDA device.
+        if self.device.type == "cuda" and self.device.index is None:
+            self.device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+        self._captured: dict[tuple, _CapturedSamplingGraph] = {}
+        # Follow SGLang's process seed while owning this worker's RNG stream.
+        # Each captured tail registers the generator so its Philox offset
+        # advances on every replay, rather than repeating capture-time coins.
+        self._generator = torch.Generator(device=self.device)
+        self._generator.manual_seed(torch.initial_seed())
+        self._rng_seed = torch.empty((1,), dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
+        self._rng_offset = torch.zeros_like(self._rng_seed)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _stage_inputs(destination, source) -> None:
+        # Always refresh the small parameter tensors. Their objects can be
+        # replaced or updated in place between requests and overlap batches.
+        for name in ("temperatures", "top_ks", "top_ps", "min_ps"):
+            getattr(destination, name).copy_(getattr(source, name))
+
+    def _run_tail(
+        self, *, logits, hidden, sampling_info, epilogue, metadata
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # Some verification kernels launch on the current CUDA device rather
+        # than selecting it from their tensors. This also covers eager tails.
+        with torch.cuda.device(self.device):
+            self._rng_seed.random_(generator=self._generator)
+            target_predict = _sample_target_tokens(
+                logits,
+                sampling_info,
+                epilogue.node_count,
+                self._rng_seed,
+                self._rng_offset,
+            )
+            req_pool_indices, seq_lens, out_cache_loc, mamba_track_indices = metadata
+            epilogue.run_from_target_predict(
+                target_predict=target_predict,
+                hidden=hidden,
+                bs=1,
+                req_pool_indices=req_pool_indices,
+                seq_lens=seq_lens,
+                out_cache_loc=out_cache_loc,
+                mamba_track_indices=mamba_track_indices,
+                broadcast_outputs=True,
+            )
+            return target_predict
+
+    def _capture(
+        self, *, logits, hidden, sampling_info, epilogue, metadata
+    ) -> _CapturedSamplingGraph:
+        graph_sampling_info = SimpleNamespace(
+            temperatures=torch.empty_like(sampling_info.temperatures),
+            top_ks=torch.empty_like(sampling_info.top_ks),
+            top_ps=torch.empty_like(sampling_info.top_ps),
+            min_ps=torch.empty_like(sampling_info.min_ps),
+            need_min_p_sampling=bool(sampling_info.need_min_p_sampling),
+        )
+        self._stage_inputs(graph_sampling_info, sampling_info)
+
+        def graph_body():
+            return self._run_tail(
+                logits=logits,
+                hidden=hidden,
+                sampling_info=graph_sampling_info,
+                epilogue=epilogue,
+                metadata=metadata,
+            )
+
+        # Warmup and capture must not commit a path to persistent KV/KDA state.
+        # The target Graph's greedy epilogue uses this same device gate.
+        epilogue.set_armed(False)
+        current_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        graph.register_generator_state(self._generator)
+        # Use the same distributed capture context as the draft Graph. It
+        # enables graph-safe TP communicators for sampled-path broadcasts and
+        # the draft cache writer's collectives.
+        with graph_capture(
+            stream=get_or_create_global_graph_capture_stream()
+        ) as capture_context:
+            capture_stream = capture_context.stream
+            for _ in range(3):
+                graph_body()
+            with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=capture_stream):
+                target_predict = graph_body()
+        current_stream.wait_stream(capture_stream)
+        return _CapturedSamplingGraph(
+            graph=graph,
+            inputs=(logits, hidden, *metadata),
+            sampling_info=graph_sampling_info,
+            target_predict=target_predict,
+            draft_kv_workspaces=epilogue.draft_kv_workspace_tensors(),
+        )
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        *,
+        logits: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden: torch.Tensor,
+        sampling_info: SamplingBatchInfo,
+        epilogue: UBTreeVerifyEpilogue,
+        forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+        can_run_cuda_graph: bool,
+    ) -> UBTreeVerifyResult:
+        if forward_batch.batch_size != 1 or sampling_info.is_all_greedy:
+            raise ValueError("UBTREE sampling tail requires one non-greedy request")
+        if sampling_info.sampling_seed is not None:
+            raise ValueError("UBTREE does not support deterministic sampling yet")
+
+        logits = logits[: epilogue.node_count]
+        hidden = hidden[: epilogue.node_count]
+        # Keep probes and NaN sanitization outside capture, as in the ordinary
+        # sampler. The tail reads logits without modifying their temperatures.
+        sanitize_nan_logits(logits, "UBTree verify: target model logits")
+        if not can_run_cuda_graph:
+            epilogue.set_armed(True)
+            self._run_tail(
+                logits=logits,
+                hidden=hidden,
+                sampling_info=sampling_info,
+                epilogue=epilogue,
+                metadata=(
+                    forward_batch.req_pool_indices,
+                    forward_batch.seq_lens,
+                    forward_batch.out_cache_loc,
+                    forward_batch.mamba_track_indices,
+                ),
+            )
+            return epilogue.read_result(1)
+
+        metadata = epilogue.graph_metadata(1)
+        inputs = (logits, hidden, *metadata)
+        # Pointer identity matters: a recaptured model or changed track buffer
+        # must not reuse a tail that still reads previous allocations.
+        key = (
+            id(epilogue),
+            bool(sampling_info.need_min_p_sampling),
+            *(
+                (tensor.data_ptr(), tensor.shape, tensor.stride(), tensor.dtype)
+                if tensor is not None
+                else None
+                for tensor in inputs
+            ),
+        )
+        captured = self._captured.get(key)
+        if captured is None:
+            # The lazy stream factory and Graph initialization also depend on
+            # the current device, before _run_tail enters its own device guard.
+            with torch.cuda.device(self.device):
+                captured = self._capture(
+                    logits=logits,
+                    hidden=hidden,
+                    sampling_info=sampling_info,
+                    epilogue=epilogue,
+                    metadata=metadata,
+                )
+            self._captured[key] = captured
+        self._stage_inputs(captured.sampling_info, sampling_info)
+        epilogue.set_armed(True)
+        captured.graph.replay()
+        return epilogue.read_result(1)
+
+
+__all__ = ["UBTreeSamplingGraphRunner"]
